strip.chatModelHelp: The model answering in chat right now. Click to change it.
strip.embeddingHelp: The model that indexes your documents so chat can search them.
strip.vramHelp: Graphics card memory in use by everything on this machine, out of the total.
strip.loadedHelp: Models Ollama is holding in memory right now. Image and video models are not listed here.
strip.indexHelp: How much of your documents is indexed for search, and how many index profiles are on. Click for the index settings.
strip.imageGenerationHelp: Whether images can be made right now. When they cannot, the line below says why.
strip.interconnectorHelp: Sync with your other Guaardvark machines. Click to open its settings.

generalPanel.title: General
generalPanel.help: Your name, picture and theme, the interface language, how pages are listed, tips, job order, the music folder and the product profile.
generalPanel.navigationHelp: How pages are listed: every page in one sidebar, or grouped by workspace in the top bar.
generalPanel.workspacesTooltip: Pages grouped by workspace in the top bar
generalPanel.mediaLibraryHelp: The music folder the assistant searches when you ask it to play music. Left empty, it uses ~/Music.

modelsPanel.title: Models
modelsPanel.help: The models that answer chat and index your documents.
modelsPanel.chatHelp: The model that writes chat replies. Pick one, then press Set active.
modelsPanel.setActiveTooltip: Loads the model, unloads the previous one and rebuilds the query engine. Can take minutes on a cold GPU.
modelsPanel.testTooltip: Sends one short prompt to the ACTIVE model, not the one selected above
modelsPanel.refreshTooltip: Refresh the model list from Ollama
modelsPanel.ollamaOffTooltip: Chat models run in Ollama. While it is off, the list shows only the saved model.
modelsPanel.startOllamaTooltip: Starts the Ollama plugin, then reloads the list
modelsPanel.keepReadyTooltip: Keeps the chat model and voice input loaded with no idle timeout, so a reply after an hour is as fast as one after a minute. It steps aside for image, video and training work and loads again when that work is done. This machine only.
modelsPanel.embeddingHelp: The model that turns your documents into a search index. Chat uses it to find passages that match your question.
modelsPanel.embeddingSetTooltip: Same vector width keeps the index. A different width empties it and every document must be re-indexed.
modelsPanel.embeddingRefreshTooltip: Refresh embedding models (probes each one, can take a moment)

chatPanel.title: Chat
chatPanel.help: What every conversation can do by default.
chatPanel.capabilitiesHelp: Features every chat can use. The gear on a chip opens that feature's settings.
chatPanel.rulesTooltip: Persona and behaviour rules from the Rules page. Off swaps them for a plain built-in prompt.
chatPanel.thinkingTooltip: Default for thinking models. Per chat: /thinking on or off.
chatPanel.webAccessTooltip: Lets the web, browser and address tools reach the internet.
chatPanel.voiceChatTooltip: Speak to the assistant and hear replies. Stored in this browser.
chatPanel.retrievalHelp: How chat answers use your documents, and what the assistant learns from you.
chatPanel.enhancedContextTooltip: Adds conversation and document context to every prompt. Applies from the next message.
chatPanel.advancedRagTooltip: Query rewriting and reranking before retrieval. Applies from the next message.
chatPanel.behaviourLearningTooltip: Learns from corrections and preferences across chats.

generationPanel.title: Generation
generationPanel.help: Default models and settings for images and video, and the model downloads for each studio.
generationPanel.promptsHelp: How your image and video prompts reach the model.
generationPanel.verbatimForcedTooltip: VERBATIM_PROMPTS is set in the server environment. Remove it and restart to control this here.
generationPanel.verbatimTooltip: On: disables AI prompt rewriting and automatic style additions. Model prompt limits and instruction-following still apply. Off: allows prompt enhancement.
generationPanel.stillsModelsHelp: The image models Guaardvark defaults to. Cast LoRA base is the model new character LoRAs are trained on; a LoRA only works with models of the same family.
generationPanel.castTrainBaseFailed: Failed to save cast train base
generationPanel.maxQualityModelFailed: Failed to save max quality model
generationPanel.betweenBatchesHelp: What happens to the image model when a batch ends. Keeping it loaded skips the reload if the next batch uses the same model.
generationPanel.unloadTooltip: Free the memory as soon as a batch ends
generationPanel.keepHourTooltip: Keep the model loaded for an hour after a batch. It holds system RAM while it waits (measured on a 16 GB card: about 21 GB for Z-Image Turbo, 31 GB for Krea 2 Turbo), and any other GPU job unloads it first.
generationPanel.keepMinutesTooltip: Keep the model loaded for {{minutes}} minutes after a batch. It holds system RAM while it waits (measured on a 16 GB card: about 21 GB for Z-Image Turbo, 31 GB for Krea 2 Turbo), and any other GPU job unloads it first.
generationPanel.loraStrengthHelp: How strongly a Cast character's look is applied to stills and keyframes, per model family (0 to 1.5). Video models carry the look over from the still.
generationPanel.identityCheckHelp: An image encoder that compares a character's post-training test picture with its reference photos, and each cinematic clip's middle frame with its keyframe. Optional: without it there is no identity score and clips are compared by colour.
generationPanel.librariesHelp: Download and manage the models behind each studio.
generationPanel.trainingTooltip: Optional Python libraries the Training page needs for fine-tuning; installed only when you click Install

knowledgePanel.title: Knowledge
knowledgePanel.help: How your documents are indexed and searched, and the overnight search tuning.
knowledgePanel.profilesHelp: Different ways of indexing the same documents. A lit profile is kept up to date and used when chat searches; the gear edits it.
knowledgePanel.indexingHelp: The queue that turns your uploaded documents into searchable data.
knowledgePanel.pausedTooltip: Paused: new documents wait instead of embedding. Useful during heavy GPU work.
knowledgePanel.optimizeTooltip: Removes vectors whose document is gone. Nothing else changes.
knowledgePanel.summariesConfirm: Build corpus summaries? This replaces the previous summary tree and uses the GPU for several minutes.
knowledgePanel.summariesFailed: Failed to queue the summary build
knowledgePanel.summariesTooltip: Builds the RAPTOR summary tree on the indexing queue. Several minutes of GPU.
knowledgePanel.pendingTooltip: Queues every document still pending or in error
knowledgePanel.rerankerHelp: A second model that rereads the passages a search found and puts the most relevant first. Searches work without it.
knowledgePanel.autoresearchHelp: Overnight tests that tune how chat searches your documents. Its settings and history are on the Autoresearch page.
knowledgePanel.nightlyTooltip: Runs one research pass in the nightly window when the machine is idle.

agentsPanel.title: Agents
agentsPanel.help: The mentor, the code guard, what the agent remembers, and what it can reach.
agentsPanel.memoryHelp: Facts, preferences and lessons the agent has learned from your chats.
agentsPanel.fileAccessHelp: Which folders the assistant's command and code tools may read.
agentsPanel.projectOnlyTooltip: On: file tools read only inside the project, its data and uploads, and GUAARDVARK_ALLOWED_PATHS. Off: they can read anywhere this account can.
agentsPanel.mcpHelp: Programs on this machine that give the agent more tools.
agentsPanel.displayHelp: A virtual screen where agents open apps and click, separate from your own desktop.

syncPanel.title: Sync
syncPanel.help: Keep code, projects and rules in step with your other Guaardvark machines. Agent memories stay on each machine.
syncPanel.interconnectorTooltip: Sync code, projects, rules and other records with the machines you have connected. Agent memories are not synced.
syncPanel.applyTooltip: Pulls every pending file from the master. Existing files are backed up first; a frontend change needs a rebuild.

dataPanel.title: Data
dataPanel.help: Backups, chat exports, and moving rules in and out.
dataPanel.backupsHelp: Save a copy of your data, restore one, or remove old copies. Export Chats writes every chat to files.
dataPanel.restoreTooltip: Overwrites live data with a backup. Confirmed inside.
dataPanel.rulesHelp: Save your rules to a file, or load rules from one. Import adds new rules and updates those with the same name.
dataPanel.importTooltip: Creates new rules and updates existing ones with the same name

dangerPanel.title: Danger zone
dangerPanel.help: Actions that delete data, restart Guaardvark or stop running models. Each one asks first and says what it does.
dangerPanel.clearLearnedTooltip: Deletes every rule marked as learned; rules you wrote stay
dangerPanel.clearLogTooltip: Empties the behaviour log that Behaviour learning reads from

developerPanel.title: Developer
developerPanel.help: Extra logging and diagnostics for troubleshooting.
developerPanel.verboseTooltip: Adds a debug log sink live; no restart.
developerPanel.clearCacheTooltip: Deletes Python bytecode caches. No data is touched.

aboutPanel.title: About
aboutPanel.supportHelp: Built with love by a solo developer. Each link opens in a new tab.

deleteHistory.title: Delete generation history
deleteHistory.description: Permanently deletes every batch image, batch video and audio generation: the files, their entries in Documents and Job History, and ComfyUI's own output and input folders.
deleteHistory.runningSkipped: Batches still generating are skipped and left in place.
deleteHistory.comfyRendering: ComfyUI is still rendering; its folders are left alone this time.
deleteHistory.countsUnavailable: Could not read the current counts; deletion still works.
deleteHistory.keeps: Film Crew productions, video editor projects, the cast library, trained LoRAs and chat history.

dialogs.embeddingDescription: Another model's vectors cannot be searched alongside the old ones, even at the same width, so the index is emptied and every indexed document is queued to be indexed again with the new model. Searches find less until that finishes.
dialogs.embeddingKeeps: your documents themselves; only their search index is rebuilt.
dialogs.rebootDescription: Restarts the backend, the workers and ComfyUI. Every generation, index job and chat reply in flight is lost, and this page will disconnect until the services are back.
dialogs.rebootKeeps: documents, chats, media, rules and settings.
dialogs.clearChatDescription: Deletes every conversation and message, the cached context files, and this browser's session ids.
dialogs.clearChatKeeps: documents, the index, generated media and rules.
dialogs.clearMemoryDescription: Deletes every memory the agent has stored: facts, preferences and lessons, whatever their status. The filters on the memory page do not narrow this.
dialogs.clearRulesDescription: Deletes every rule marked as learned: the ones shipped in the rule bundle, and any saved by the /saverule command. The chat does not add rules on its own.
dialogs.clearLogDescription: Empties the behaviour log file that Behaviour learning reads to adapt replies. Learning starts again from nothing.
dialogs.clearRulesKeeps: rules you wrote or imported, chats, memories.
